question: How did each salesperson's annual total sales compare to their annual sales quota? Provide the difference between their total sales and the quota for each year, organized by salesperson and year.
sql:
-- Final query with rounded values - showing all rows
WITH annual_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER) as businessentityid,
        TRY_CAST(year(CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as sales_year,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(totaldue AS DOUBLE)) as annual_total_sales
    FROM salesorderheader
    WHERE TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(year(CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER)
),
annual_quota AS (
    SELECT 
        TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER) as businessentityid,
        TRY_CAST(year(CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as quota_year,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE)) as annual_quota_total
    FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    GROUP BY TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(year(CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT 
    a.businessentityid,
    a.sales_year as year,
    ROUND(a.annual_total_sales, 2) as annual_total_sales,
    ROUND(q.annual_quota_total, 2) as annual_quota_total,
    ROUND(a.annual_total_sales - q.annual_quota_total, 2) as difference
FROM annual_sales a
INNER JOIN annual_quota q ON a.businessentityid = q.businessentityid AND a.sales_year = q.quota_year
ORDER BY a.businessentityid, a.sales_year
